title: setup
summary: Install the small shell function that lets `cwm get <name> -x` run in your current shell.
notes: CWM adds one managed block to your profile (Bash, Zsh or PowerShell). Only that block is added or replaced.
A backup of your profile is saved once as `<profile>.cwm.bak` before the first change.
The function runs inside your shell, so `cd` and environment changes from a saved command stay after it finishes.
History options of your shell are not changed.

flags.name: --force
flags.desc: Pick the shell from a menu when auto-detection is wrong.

examples.title: Detect the shell and install the block
